description: This file provides a class `OpenAIGPT5Config` that extends `OpenAIGPTConfig` to support configuration and parameter handling for OpenAI's GPT-5 model series, including specific handling for GPT-5-Codex variants and related models. It includes methods to identify specific model variants and to map parameters for API calls, accounting for model-specific quirks and unsupported features.

classes.name: OpenAIGPT5Config
classes.description: Configuration class for GPT-5 models, handling specific model recognition and parameter mapping suited for GPT-5 series including Codex variants.

methods.name: bool is_model_gpt_5_model(cls, model: str)
methods.description: Checks if the provided model string indicates a GPT-5 model.

methods.name: bool is_model_gpt_5_codex_model(cls, model: str)
methods.description: Checks if the model is specifically a GPT-5 Codex variant.

methods.name: bool is_model_gpt_5_1_codex_max_model(cls, model: str)
methods.description: Checks if the model is the gpt-5.1-codex-max variant.

methods.name: bool is_model_gpt_5_1_model(cls, model: str)
methods.description: Determines if the model is a gpt-5.1 or gpt-5.2 chat variant.

methods.name: bool is_model_gpt_5_2_pro_model(cls, model: str)
methods.description: Checks if the model is gpt-5.2-pro snapshot/alias.

methods.name: bool is_model_gpt_5_2_model(cls, model: str)
methods.description: Checks if the model is a gpt-5.2 variant, including pro models.

methods.name: list get_supported_openai_params(self, model: str)
methods.description: Returns the list of OpenAI API parameters supported for the given model, including additional GPT-5 specific parameters.

methods.name: dict map_openai_params( self, non_default_params: dict, optional_params: dict, model: str, drop_params: bool, )
methods.description: Maps non-default and optional parameters for API requests, applying model-specific rules and handling unsupported parameters for GPT-5 models.
